answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The copper holds work receipts rather than names, so the vault of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
